newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Nice introduces two new products.
newsitem.headline: Nice introduces two new products.

text.p: Nice Systems Ltd, an Israeli maker of digital voice logging and computer telephony applications, introduced two new products on Monday.
NiceFax manages incoming and outgoing fax traffic and increases security by storing sensitive documents and controlling access to these documents.
NiceLog, a disk-based computer telephony integration voice logging system, provides digital recordings and archival of telephone conversations.
"Nice is set to continue its growth in 1997 and these new products will enhance growth," Nice president Benny Levin said in a statement.
Nice is also traded in Tel Aviv.
